get.description: Return the whole topology, as documented with the changes accepted.

Return the state of everything monitored, as of now or an earlier moment.

The present is rounded down to the polling interval, and each moment
is served from one cached, already compressed copy.

Return the problems in the state as of now or an earlier moment,
with the maintenance that accounts for each, who is on it, the team
that owns it, and where its page stands.

Pass the ``generated_at`` of the state being shown, so the two match.

post.description: Return what failing some devices, sites, and links would do.

get.description: Return the changes the source saw over its whole history.

Return what the incoming shift needs to know about the last hours:
what is wrong now and who is on it, outages that began or ended,
pages and acknowledgements made, maintenance done, open, and coming,
fixes recorded, discovery findings first seen, who is on call, and
the notes written since the last shift change.

Return the handovers saved at shift changes, latest first, and
when the shift changes next.

Return a handover saved at a shift change, as it was then, with
the notes the outgoing shift wrote.

post.description: Write a note for the next shift; it goes with the next handover.

delete.description: Withdraw a note that has not been handed over yet.

get.description:
Return the discovery run in effect now, or at an earlier moment,
compared with the documented links, with when each finding was seen,
and the findings marked expected set aside.

Runs come every 15 minutes, and each is compared once for every viewer.
Return one device's readings over the source's whole history.

schema.title: Response List Windows Api Maintenance Get

post.description: Acknowledge a problem there is now, with a note.

get.description:
Return who is on call for every team, now or at an earlier moment,
and how to reach them and the carriers.
Return the team that owns each site, device, and link.

post.description:
Page the team that owns a problem there is now.

Nothing is sent: the page is recorded, and escalates on paper.
Put someone on call in place of a team's primary for a while.

get.description: Return every fix accepted into the documentation, newest first.

post.description:
Accept the fix a finding of the latest discovery run offers into
the documentation, which everything then follows; or mark the
finding expected, which changes no link.

get.description:
Return what accepting the fix a finding of the latest discovery run
offers would do now: to the ports involved, to redundancy, and to the
problems there are. Or, to mark it expected, what Live reads now on
the ports it is about.

delete.description: Take a fix back out of the documentation, or withdraw an expectation.

get.description: List saved layouts, most recently saved first.

Change.title: Change

Circuit.title: Circuit

Comparison.title: Comparison

CoverIn.title: CoverIn
CoverIn.description: Someone taking a team's primary turn for a while.

DeviceCenter.description: A neighborhood built around one device.

DeviceHistory.description:
One device's readings at regular steps, oldest first.

Step ``i`` is at ``start + i * step_s``. Values are None where there was
no fresh reading: the device was down, cut off, or not reporting.

DeviceState.description: Whether a monitored device answers, and how quickly.

EventLog.description: The changes seen between two moments, oldest first.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description: One place where the documentation and the network disagree.

Fix.title: Fix
Fix.description:
A change to the documentation that makes it say what discovery sees,
or for ``expect``, that records a finding as expected.

message.description:
The handover written to post in chat or send by email.

HandoverSummary.description: A saved handover, in a line.

Impact.title: Impact
Impact.description: What some failures do to the network.

InterfaceHistory.title: InterfaceHistory

LayoutIn.title: LayoutIn
LayoutIn.description: A layout as the browser sends it.

LayoutSummary.title: LayoutSummary
LayoutSummary.description: A stored layout without its positions, for listing.

id.title: Id

Stable identifier that does not depend on which end is listed first.

Message.description: A handover written to post in chat or send by email.

NetworkState.title: NetworkState
NetworkState.description: One snapshot of everything a source monitors.
